title: Recorded invocation reader
responsibility: Reads recorded function input/output cases while distinguishing missing or malformed evidence.

inputs.name: artifactCases.document
inputs.description: Parsed artifact document of unknown shape.

inputs.name: artifactCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional expected unit identifier. When supplied, recorded invocations must name that unit.

outputs.name: caseForm
outputs.description: Supported form: schema version 1, function-invocations kind, at most 64 cases and case names up to 160 characters.

outputs.name: artifactCases
outputs.description: Returns invocation cases only when every case has a nonempty bounded name, input and exactly one of output or error, with valid unit/symbol metadata. Otherwise returns a stated gap. Legacy top-level input/inputs/request plus output/outputs/response become one observation row; false, zero, null and empty values are retained.
